acceptance.notes: A hard fail means the video cannot pass, whatever the score is. Fix it and re-render.
acceptance.scale: 0-10 per category, weighted average = overall score

categories.description: Same character, same costume, same proportions and face in every shot. No head/body ratio drift, no costume or prop swapping mid-scene. V51 rig standard headRatio 0.142-0.155.
categories.name: character_consistency

categories.description: Environment matches the story and stays consistent: same location, lighting, time of day, no objects appearing/disappearing without cause. No empty room where the script says there is a lantern, no floating props.
categories.name: scene_environment

categories.description: Native 1920x1080, 24 fps, no black bars, no pillarbox/letterbox, no 9:16 crop. Critical action inside the inner 84% frame, captions inside the inner 80%. Camera never hides the main action behind a pillar, wall or crowd.
categories.name: camera_framing_16x9

categories.description: Movement is continuous, no teleporting poses, no frozen character for seconds, no limbs clipping through objects or the ground, feet stay on the ground plane.
categories.name: motion_smoothness

categories.description: Hook lands in the first 3 seconds, one clear idea per shot, twist at 70-85% of the runtime, short payoff at the end. No filler shot that could be removed without losing the story.
categories.name: story_hook_twist_payoff

categories.description: Every voice line is present in full, in order, at the planned time. No final line cut off, no line starting late, no line running past the end of the video. Speech speed 1.00x, no pitch distortion.
categories.name: voice_narration_timing

categories.description: SFX and music match what is on screen and start on time: footsteps, rain, paper, doors, crowd. Music and ambience duck -14 dB under speech. No SFX that belongs to another scene, no silent stretch where the script needs sound.
categories.name: sfx_music_sync

categories.description: Captions are readable at 1080p and on a phone: minimum 64 px, max 2 lines x 42 chars, lower third inside the safe title area, high contrast, no clipping, no typo, no missing line.
categories.name: captions_legibility

how_to_score: Score each category 0-10 after watching the full video and checking the contact sheet frame by frame. Use the technical evaluator (evaluate_16x9.py) for the measurable parts — resolution, fps, duration, black bars, audio presence, caption overflow, TTS fit — and score character/scene/motion/story by direct visual inspection. Record the evidence for every score under 8: file, timestamp, and what is wrong. Iterate: fix the lowest-scoring category first, re-render, re-score. Stop only when overall >= 8.0, every category >= 7.0, and there are no hard fails.
